India navigates Hormuz crisis, averting energy disruption

India's energy diplomacy faced a significant challenge due to disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz, a critical global energy transit point. Despite the risks, India managed to maintain fuel price stability and keep essential services running. Experts and former officials attribute this success to a robust system built over years and a customer-first strategy, highlighting India's resilience in managing energy security during international crises.
